steps.expected: RIG-16: tracks a live bramblebun's own position every frame instead of a fixed cluster-centre coordinate.

steps.observation: RIG-F2, fixed 2026-08-31 (lane ralph/GATE-F-LEG-S03). This step used to be `press interact times: 2`, on the assumption that two taps arm the aim. `interact` TOGGLES the aim, so two taps arm and disarm it whenever it was already armed when the block began, and the throw that follows lands on the wrong parity and emits nothing. Measured on this lane's first S02 run: ONE catch_throw out of four throw blocks. The cost is not only the missed throws -- the segment then stands still through four six-second waits while the opponent keeps attacking, and that is what fainted the starter and produced a handoff save with a party of one and 0 HP. press_until reaches the state instead of guessing at it (CD-3), and PASSes on zero presses when the aim is already armed, which is exactly the case the fixed count got wrong.

steps.expected: T2-BUILDPLACE ROUND 2 (FINDING-T2-BUILDPLACE-2026-08-30.md, round 3): replaces the round-2 fix's blind creature_recall dismiss here. That dismiss cleared the blanket "is out of the fight" override (still true and still needed -- see the note below) but ALSO zeroed _ally, and encounter_director.gd::can_challenge() refuses a null ally exactly like a fainted one (line ~1568). Live-confirmed this round: with the dismiss in place, Bryn's own _on_challenged() (trainer_npc.gd) read can_challenge()==false and opened his 'defeated' conversation instead of 'challenge' for every subsequent replay -- no fight ever started, so S03-48/S03-50's combat_quick presses hit nothing, S03-51a's level-up capture had no level-up to catch, and the training rung's own evidence (Section L.4 T05/T06, GF-14-COMBAT-02) was never real. autoload/party.gd::cycle_active() skips fainted/resting members and is a documented no-op when the active creature is already the only healthy one (returns false, revision untouched), so pressing it here is safe regardless of outcome: if the catch loop's deployed ally fainted, this moves `active` to a live party member and encounter_director.gd::_sync_active_creature() (polled every frame off party.revision in _process()) dismisses the fainted body and summons the new active one; if the ally did not faint, this just cycles to a different live member, which costs nothing.
